description: This file defines the NavigationCategory class, which models a navigation category with a type, optional category string, and account ID, used within the Nextcloud Notes Android client project.

classes.name: NavigationCategory
classes.description: A model class representing a navigation category with a specific type, optional category string, and associated account ID.

methods.name: NavigationCategory(@NonNull ENavigationCategoryType type)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a NavigationCategory with a specified type, throws an exception if the type is DEFAULT_CATEGORY.

methods.name: NavigationCategory(long accountId, @Nullable String category)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a NavigationCategory with an account ID and optional category string, sets type to DEFAULT_CATEGORY.

methods.name: getType()
methods.description: Returns the type of the navigation category.

methods.name: getAccountId()
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with this navigation category.

methods.name: getCategory()
methods.description: Returns the category string, if any.

methods.name: equals(Object o)
methods.description: Checks equality based on type, accountId, and category.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on type, category, and accountId.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NavigationCategory object.
